title: Mike Turner, Wright-Patterson donors and the eminent domain clause

plain: Congressman Mike Turner represents the Ohio district home to Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, which Michels calls the center of UFO legend and of efforts to copy recovered craft, going back to the reported 1947 crash at Roswell, New Mexico. Michels says Turner's top donors include Boeing and Lockheed, both big aircraft and weapons makers. He tells it himself as background to a 2023 fight in Congress over an eminent domain clause, a rule that would let the government take private property, suggesting Turner's ties to these companies shaped that fight.
